title: The Uttar Pradesh Government Servant (Discipline and Appeal) Rules, 1999
titleHi: उत्तर प्रदेश सरकारी सेवक (अनुशासन एवं अपील) नियमावली, 1999
sourceNote: Official (Government of Uttar Pradesh website, hosted on the UP Police government domain). The PDF contains the complete 1999 Rules and states that they superseded the Civil Service (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1930 and the Punishment and Appeal Rules for Subordinate Service, Uttar Pradesh, 1932.
